products.overview: Seeing how single molecules interact means holding them and watching them at once. The LUMICKS C-Trap is a dynamic single-molecule microscope that lets you manipulate and visualize single-molecule interactions simultaneously, in real time, combining optical traps, multicolor fluorescence imaging and laminar microfluidics. Automated runs take under 80 seconds including assay assembly, 18 usable datasets are possible in half an hour, and sample loading to data analysis takes under 30 minutes.

faqs.question: What is the LUMICKS C-Trap?
faqs.answer: The C-Trap is a dynamic single-molecule microscope that lets you manipulate and visualize single-molecule interactions simultaneously, in real time.

faqs.question: What does the C-Trap combine?
faqs.answer: Optical traps for precise sample manipulation, multicolor fluorescence imaging and laminar microfluidics, with Bluelake and Lakeview software.

faqs.question: How long does a C-Trap experiment take?
faqs.answer: From sample loading to data analysis in under 30 minutes. Automated runs take under 80 seconds, including assay assembly.

faqs.question: How many datasets can the C-Trap produce?
faqs.answer: 18 usable datasets are possible in half an hour.

faqs.question: What can the C-Trap fluorescence imaging study?
faqs.answer: Protein kinetics and (un)binding on DNA, and conformational changes via FRET. Fast 1D scanning suits DNA and filaments.

faqs.question: How does the C-Trap microfluidics work?
faqs.answer: A 5-channel automated microfluidics system with a dedicated laminar flowcell lets you test multiple proteins or conditions in one experiment, with twist-and-lock syringe adaptors for quick refills.

faqs.question: Which research areas use the C-Trap?
faqs.answer: DNA-binding proteins, protein folding, phase separation, mechanobiology, and cytoskeletal structure and transport.

faqs.question: What software runs the C-Trap?
faqs.answer: Bluelake for experiment execution, trap control and automation; Lakeview for statistical analysis across multiple measurements.

faqs.question: What is the price of the C-Trap in India?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the configuration and options. Contact Inkarp for a quotation on +91 8125580808 or info@inkarp.co.in.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor for the C-Trap in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the LUMICKS C-Trap in India, with support for installation, training, AMC and application support.

sections.glanceDescription: Everything you need to evaluate the C-Trap, including optical traps, fluorescence imaging, microfluidics, software and research applications.
intro: The overview of the C-Trap covers its role in dynamic single-molecule research.

The LUMICKS C-Trap brings together precise sample manipulation with optical traps, multicolor fluorescence imaging and laminar microfluidics in one platform, so single-molecule interactions can be manipulated and visualized at the same time.
Bluelake software runs experiments, trap control and automation, while Lakeview supports statistical analysis across multiple measurements.
